name: learn
description: Resumable tutoring that diagnoses, plans, teaches, waits for real answers and keeps the learning record in a local folder.

interface.shortDescription: Study a topic over several sessions with a resumable tutor
interface.longDescription: Diagnose what the learner knows, agree a small plan, teach one step at a time, wait for real answers and assess them against rubrics written before each question. Goals, answers, hints, progress and cited sources stay in a local learning folder that Claude Code and Codex can both resume.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me study this topic step by step and keep my progress in a learning folder.
